How many votes in the 342-member Nationa.question: How many votes in the 336-member National Assembly are needed to pass a no-confidence motion against the Prime Minister?
How many votes in the 342-member Nationa.reason: A no-confidence resolution needs a majority of the total membership of the House. Half of 336 is 168, so 169 votes are needed.
How many votes in the 342-member Nationa.rel: Article 95 of the Constitution deals with the vote of no confidence against the Prime Minister. The National Assembly had 342 seats before 2018.

How many seats did the National Assembly.rel: The National Assembly now has 336 seats: 266 general seats, 60 reserved for women and 10 for non-Muslims.
